name: Godavari Drugs Limited
about: Godavari Drugs Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), drug intermediaries, and fine chemicals in India. The company offers APIs, including ciprofloxacin hydrochloride (HCL), ciprofloxacin lactate, ciprofloxacin betaine, carbamazepine, enrofloxacin, mefenamic acid, ambroxol hydrochloride, piracetam, as well as 2,5-dihydroxy-1,4- dithiane. It also provides loan licenses and contract manufacturing services for APIs and drug intermediates. The company serves the life science industry. Godavari Drugs Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
